findings.claim: Legacy renderer compound dispatchers bypass rejection preflight and lose move source data.
findings.detail: Move /state/source to /state/items/01 through built useUIStream deletes source and rejects destination; malformed copy source creates own undefined. Base transfers a value instead. React directly exercised; sibling frameworks statically traced.

findings.claim: StateProvider reports rejected batch entries as actual changes.
findings.detail: Mixed /items/01 and /count update preserves array at head but callback still includes rejected value; base callback matched the coerced write.

findings.claim: Malformed copy-source test ignores an own undefined property and survives removal of its fix.
findings.detail: toEqual ignores an extra undefined-valued own property. An own-key assertion or strict equality protects the claimed no-undefined insertion behavior.
